The roof of the building is two large peaks and one smaller peak that covers the corner portion of the building. The roof itself is made of red ceramic tiles and two large brick chimneys extend themselves in transverse orientation on the east and west side of the building. The remnants of a beautifully wrought iron chandelier hang from the roof, just above a decayed wooden table. [Dremsyl's Tower, Dining Room]
The remnants of a beautifully wrought iron chandelier hang from the roof, just above a decayed wooden table. The room is smaller than the main dining room, perhaps the personal dining area of the master of the tower. The tapestries that still hang on the walls reveal in faded color that they were once masterpieces. A sodden piece of cloth covers the floor beneath the rotten wood table, it appears to be the hide of some great furred beast, but the water has damaged it beyond recognition. Because of the awkward tilting of the tower, much of the water streaming through the rest of the first floor has made its way here. Years of corrosive water has finally worn away the thick stone wall and the water has at last found a way out of the tower via dozens of holes where large stones once were. The water cascades out the holes in a constant stream into a cavern so dark no amount of light seems able to penetrate it.

The area is illuminated.

In this room you see: Seren the Human (holding a flaming softly glowing frozen veil lantern),  Harru the Galirrim,  Blackbreeze the Human

[Dremsyl's Tower, Shrine to Ty'ghat]
The hidden shrine to the ancient evil of the dragon Ty'ghat has been overrun by the massive mind of the monstrous flesh beast that has taken over the tower. An imposing statue that was once of a terrifying black scaled dragon has been crushed by a rubbery appendage attempting to support the base of a vast brain. The gray flesh of the brain pulses with stolen magical energies and a shimmering rainbow of lights surround the brain matter in an entrancing aura. Glaring, blood-shot eyes stare out across the room, watching for any creature dim-witted enough to walk right into the heart of the hostile beast. The smell of rotting meat has become overpowering as the creature throbs with boundless rage and its massive limbs thrash with abandon. A screeching hum fills the room from an unidentifiable source, as the monster seems to have no true mouth with which to speak.

The hidden shrine to the ancient evil of the dragon Ty'ghat has been overrun by the massive mind of the monstrous flesh beast that has taken over the tower. An imposing statue that was once of a terrifying black scaled dragon has been crushed by a rubbery appendage attempting to support the base of a vast brain. Glaring, blood-shot eyes stare out across the room, watching for any creature dim-witted enough to walk right into the heart of the hostile beast. The smell of rotting meat has become overpowering as the creature throbs with boundless rage and its massive limbs thrash with abandon. Small trinkets of adoration and worship have been left at the base of the altar, each one a symbol of devotion to their beloved gods.

[Urda Town Square Center]
On this site, a fierce battle for control of the great city was waged, and on this site is where its citizens now celebrate that victory. Statues of the fallen heroes, and great leaders of the alliance adorn the tops of grand marble archways that scatter over the square. They stand ever vigilant against any unseen enemy. [Merchant Square]
A small sign has been set in front of the nearby store fronts, listing the local shops: Regal Fashion, Banafin's Bakery, and Sadie's General Store. An eye-catching black striped tiger is emblazoned on the facade of lacquered wooden building on the south side of the square. Its shoulders raised high, and face frozen in a fierce roar. Through the many, high-arched, steel frame windows, a wooden figure can be seen wearing the latest gentleman's fashion. Grey smoke rises from a single stone chimney. A simple plaque hanging from a twisted wrought iron rod reads, "Regal Fashion". Smooth stone steps lead to the entrance. On the east side of the street a large brick chimney funnels white billowy smoke into the air projecting the aroma of fresh baked goods into the area. Through the large bay window a burly human man can be seen kneading and forming dough and placing his creations into an oven. The heavy mahogany door is propped seemingly propped to allow for relief from the ovens intense heat. A quaint barn faces the square from the west side of the street, its interior remodeled into a storefront, as seen through its large bay window.

The area is illuminated.

Obvious exits are: northwest, west, south, east, northeast, north, closed crooked red barn door, closed mahogany door, steps
